title: Half the Island Looks Away
hook_line: Hold the rope and count the tide
central_image: a shuttered shop with its paint peeling line by line

## Notes

The refrain is an instruction a deckhand might give, so it stays in the body rather than in the feelings. The bridge turns the direction of travel around for next summer.
